summary: Enhance your finance skills with our Business Intelligence and Analytics course. Learn to leverage data for informed decision-making and drive success.
lede: Business Intelligence and Analytics for Finance Professionals helps you move beyond static spreadsheets by turning raw financial data into actionable insights. Over five days, you will learn practical methods for automated data extraction, variance analysis, predictive trend modeling, stakeholder storytelling, and data governance. You will work with ETL processes using Power Query, build calculations with DAX, and design executive dashboards that highlight critical KPIs. The course also introduces machine learning and Python for finance while keeping the focus on practical implementation, IFRS and COSO-aligned reporting, and faster financial decision-making.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for finance practitioners who need to modernize their analytical toolkit and move toward automated, data-driven workflows.
modules: Modern Finance Data Ecosystem and BI Foundations
Data Architecture and ETL for Finance Professionals
Advanced Financial Visualization and Dashboard Design
Predictive Analytics and Financial Forecasting Models
Risk Analytics and Internal Compliance Monitoring
Data Governance and Collaborative BI Ecosystems
Strategic BI Integration and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of financial reporting (P&L, Balance Sheet) and intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel® (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables). No prior experience with Power BI®, Tableau®, or SQL® is required, as these will be introduced during the course.
